rules.description: Wholesale customers get an 8% discount on the line.
rules.action: Net = gross x (1 - 0.08), rounded half up to cents. Gross = qty x unit price.

rules.description: Government customers get a 5% discount on the line.
rules.action: Net = gross x (1 - 0.05), rounded half up to cents.

rules.description: Retail customers get no customer-type discount.
rules.condition: Customer type is anything other than W or G.

rules.description: Volume discount of 3% on lines of 100 units or more, applied after the customer discount, so the two compound.
rules.action: Net = net x (1 - 0.03), rounded half up to cents.

rules.description: Small-order fee of $4.95 when the discounted net is under $25.00, except for government customers.
rules.condition: Net under 25.00 and customer type is not G.

rules.description: The small-order fee is added to net before tax is computed, so the fee is taxed.
rules.action: Tax is computed on net including the fee.

rules.description: Sales tax by state: Texas 6.25%, California 7.25%, every other state 5%.
rules.action: Tax = net x rate, rounded half up to cents. Total = net + tax.

rules.description: Government customers are exempt from sales tax.
rules.action: Tax rate is zero, so total = net.

rules.description: Credit hold: the order goes on hold if the open balance plus this total exceeds the credit limit. Exactly at the limit is approved.

open_questions: Policy question: the volume break was added in 2003 under pricing memo PM-114 (line 5). Is it still current policy, or a rule nobody remembers adding?
